summary: Update the backend runtime to Node.js 24.22.3 and the managed-shard bootstrap runtime to Node.js 26.13.1 to fix CVE-2026-123863, a denial of service caused by improper HTTP/2 session teardown.
userImpact: No behavior change. The backend keeps the Node.js 24 major, the bootstrap keeps the Node.js 26 major, and both keep their existing configuration.

instructions: Deploy the new backend image. No configuration or data changes are needed.

configuration: No new runtime configuration is required.

notes: Migration inventories and schema-plan identities remain unchanged.

security: Pin the Wolfi backend runtime to nodejs-24 24.22.3-r2 and the managed-shard bootstrap runtime to nodejs-26 26.13.1-r1, both of which contain the fix for CVE-2026-123863 (HIGH).
documentation: docs/runbooks/security-dependency-updates.md records the new backend and bootstrap Node.js pins.
rollback: Restore the previous image only after independently checking its current security acceptance.
validation: Dependency-security override and managed-shard bootstrap tests, both runtime image builds and exact-image vulnerability scans.

customerDocumentation.reason: The runtime patch keeps existing behavior and needs no configuration change.
